title: Section 15 CPC — Lowest grade competent court

content.overview: Section 15 CPC requires every suit to be instituted in the court of the lowest grade competent to try it. Grade is not the same as territorial or pecuniary competence.
content.study: Start with competence: subject-matter, pecuniary, territorial. Then apply Section 15. Filing in a higher grade when a lower competent court exists is a grade error, not automatically a want of jurisdiction. Sections 16 to 20 answer where. Section 15 answers which grade.
